basis: 1190 captured source-to-beat beneficiary loss; compare current completion gate with source-aware candidate. Candidate is experimental, not production.

cases.source: Amy is at home on a normal day, wearing a tight, black tank top and denim jeans, cooking breakfast for her young kids.
cases.beat: Amy cooks breakfast in the kitchen, wearing a tight black tank top and denim jeans while her children Will and Amber watch.
cases.raw_scene:
At 00:00.000 Amy flips a pancake in a skillet on the stove, her tight black tank top and denim jeans visible.
At 00:01.000 She pours milk into a bowl placed on the counter.
At 00:02.000 A toaster pops up toast on the counter beside the bowl.
At 00:03.000 Amy places a plate with pancakes on the counter.
At 00:04.000 Will watches her, eyes on the skillet.
At 00:05.000 Amber watches too, peering at the sizzling pancake.
At 00:06.000 She lifts the spatula to flip another pancake.
At 00:07.000 Amy sets the spatula down, turns off the stove, and smiles.
End continuity state: Amy stands in the kitchen wearing a tight black tank top and denim jeans, having cooked breakfast while Will and Amber watch.
cases.rationale: Named children merely watch; no completed result reaches them.
